sign.operation: Hold a static wide of Odysseus seated on the rock, back to us, head bowed toward the horizon, for eight seconds before Calypso enters the frame.

scenes.world: A rocky headland over a hazy empty sea in hard afternoon light turning to dusk, no ships anywhere; Mediterranean travelogue colour.

captain.asks: Hold a static wide of Odysseus on the rock, back to us, bowed to the empty sea, then let the oath play as bodies of attitude.
diagnosis: The sepia rocky shore gives a strong single world for the wides; the colour travelogue breaks in and out.
Odysseus has no stable body: closed eyes, a portrait, a profile; his attitude is never held long enough.
The oath has no gesture: no raised hand exists, so the scene's hinge plays on landscape.
